title.narrative: EU Visibility and Communication in the Republic of Moldova 2025-2026

description.narrative:
The overall objective to which this action contributes is to support EU public diplomacy and increased visibility of the EU and the EU assistance provided to the Republic of Moldova. This objective is achieved through providing targeted information on tangible results for the Moldovan citizens and constant communication about the reforms aiming to align to the EU acquis in the context of opening of negotiations for Moldova to join EU.

Moreover, a special focus will be placed on the role and importance of European values and culture, thus providing a pivotal role to communication activities focused around cultural aspects, both of the EU and the Republic of Moldova.

The specific objectives of this contract are as follows:

·     Specific Objective 1: To ensure an efficient implementation of physical and online communication events and initiatives dedicated to the celebration of Europe Day;

·     Specific Objective 2: To increase visibility of the EU and the EU assistance among target groups via providing support to organisation of various public diplomacy and ad-hoc events;

·     Specific Objective 3: To ensure the management of online communication tools of the EU Delegation and to provide support for communication activities of the EU Delegation.
